_doc: A Conferência dos Cometinhos (ConferenceBook, src/tycoon/conference/conference_book.gd; ConferenceFlow and the fair scene scenes/tycoon/conference/conference_fair.tscn). Every `every_years` campaign years from `first_year` on, at week `week` of that year, an invitation (the 'conference' screen) asks the player to go to the fair: the clock holds while it is up and while the player is there. At the fair the player walks their leader Cometling (third person, over the shoulder) among the Lendas and the rival agencies' stands. Who comes: the rival leaders (always, at their agency's stand), the host (`host`, the fair's gossip, always) and every other Lenda whose era has come (legends.json `era` <= the campaign era; `skip` never comes). Lendas with a campus exchange of their own (chatter.json pairs whose `if` / `b_if` name two Lendas) stand together and trade it when the player walks up. The rival news is live race state (RaceDirector, SpaceTracking): milestones, firsts, the next goal and its era, what they took and what blew up since `news_since_years` (or the last conference), the months a failure still holds them back, and how many milestones they are from the Mother-Ice; every sentence is an i18n template of i18n/conference_strings.csv (TY_CONF_*). `reward`: reputation / hype the agency gets once per conference it attends; `rival_reward`: hype for each rival leader whose report the player hears (once per conference each). Kept in TycoonState.conference: {"last_year": the year of the last invitation answered, "attended": [years], "skipped": [years], "heard": [rival ids heard at the current conference], "talked": [Lenda ids talked to at the current conference]}. The fair takes the campus' time of day: its sun copies the campus key light, never weaker than `min_sun`. The triennium (ConferenceTriennium, src/tycoon/conference/conference_triennium.gd): `reactions`: the rival leaders (and the mentor Lendas of `lendas`) say what they make of the player's own three years when asked ('E o que dizem da gente?'): the firsts the player took (a first the rival was after is a 'stole'), its later milestones, its launches since then (ProjectDesk history: failures; SpaceTracking: missions lost in operation), and the reputation gained since the last invitation; each `voices` entry names the voice of TY_CONF_YOU_<VOICE>_<SITUATION> (others speak as LENDA); a change under `rep_flat` points is 'flat'. `tip`: Keplerino's gossip about one rival's next goal can become a tip: the first rival (in the rivals' order) whose next milestone has a race briefing in `briefings` (milestone id -> briefing id) the agency can take now (BriefingDesk.eligible: its era has come, the target reachable, not solved nor taken; the milestone not the player's yet) gets a choice in the host's report; hearing it puts that briefing on the mission board for `weeks` weeks (reward x `reward_mult`), at most `per_conference` per conference. `award`: the 'Agência do triênio' is held on the stage (the Ceremony node of the fair scene; walk up to it): score = `first` per first + `milestone` per milestone taken since the last conference + `rep` per reputation point gained (a rival's is the milestones' own rep, halved for a later claim, as the player gets it) - `fail` per launch lost; the best score wins (ties: the player, then the rivals' order), nobody when no score is above zero. The award is decided once per conference (at the ceremony, else when leaving the fair); if the player wins, `reward` once and a trophy. State added: "rep_marks": {year: reputation when that invitation was answered}, "tip": {"year", "rival", "briefing", "milestone", "expires_week"}, "awards": {year: winner id ("player", a rival id or "")}, "trophies": [years the player won].
